title: Vanishing Noise Modulus
statement: Fix a natural number $k$. For $0\leq\delta\leq\tfrac12$, define $\omega_k(\delta)=\min\{1,3\delta^{2^{-k}}\}$. As positive $\delta$ in this interval tends to $0$, $\omega_k(\delta)$ tends to $0$.
hypotheses_covered: the limit is taken as $\delta$ tends to $0$ through positive values in $[0,\tfrac12]$
